text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which 
must be performed on annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
Technical Specification:
11,12 BTA10 | Battery Title
2x27 | Number of cell / monoblocs
20-30 c | Ambient temperature
2.23 v/cell | Battery voltage
The first draft initiated by eng. Mamdouh Ahmed Abd El-Gelil, tested by 
eng. Abd El-Gayed Abd El-Wahab Shawky Atalla, accepted by general manager eng 
Mostafa Abd El-Sattar El-Kalmoush 
and approved by eng. Ebrahim Mahmoud Aly Hassan head sector of Talkha Power Station.
This 
document revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar , certified by eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil 
general manager of quality control & MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. 
Mohamed Naguib Abd El-Hay head sector of inspection and quality control.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued, qualified maintenance staff carry the suitable safety 
 ID category
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Use standard personal 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, goggles 
 protective clothing rubber gloves .... etc
The unit must be on 
 service
Complete tool set
Hydrometer
Digital voltmeter and 
 clamp meter
Grace battery
Thermometer
Work to be carried out
Measure and record 
 the voltage of all cells/monoblocs batteries
Measure and record 
 the electrolyte density of all cells/ monoblocs batteries
Measure and record 
 the level of cell/ monoblocs batteries
Measure and record 
 the battery voltage
Measure and record 
 the temperature of all cells/ monoblocs batteries
Check that unsecured 
 bolt connectors are firmly seated
Check the ventilation 
 of room batteries
